A nested table flattened into a cell keeps its row boundaries as literal <br> when br_in_tables is enabled

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<table><tr><td><p>Before</p><table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>123</td><td>Done</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("br_in_tables" = TRUE, "compact_tables" = TRUE), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
